text: The person set a standing rule for scientific tolerances (2026-11-18, docs/ideas/20261118.md, 'Tolerances by a standing rule'): the reference's stated uncertainty where the source states one, else half a unit in the last digit the reference prints; where neither applies the task stays undecided; a tolerance the person gave overrides it (Cantera 1 K, GROMACS exact counts, CFD-T stand). contracts/schemas/validation_report.schema.json now takes tolerance.chosen_by 'rule' with rule, derived_by (computed:<skill>@vN) and from (stated_uncertainty | last_printed_digit). Asked of the meta role: (1) a library skill that derives the tolerance from a reference as read (its printed text, or its stated uncertainty), run through the runner, shown on fixtures of two unrelated kinds; (2) the template's validate_tasks.py, which today accepts only chosen_by human, to accept chosen_by rule with its derivation and to judge by it; (3) the Designer to fill such tolerances where the person gave none.
